scope: Arithmetic, chronology and immutability using actual saved features and labelled profile probes

manifest.split_rule: Chronological first floor(4*N/5) development; remainder held out
manifest.scaling_convention: Population standard deviation (ddof=0), constant feature scale=1
manifest.technical_convention: Mean of five technical z-scores; larger values are trend-positive
manifest.sentiment_convention: Z-score of mean_polarity; missing held-out news -> zero signal
manifest.formula: C = R*S + (1-R)*T; R = reconciled prototype profile score
manifest.limitation: New retrospective comparator; not a reconstruction of historical CV or personalized XGBoost.
